subject: GCP private offer: retroactive burn reconciliation & legal handoff
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan@glacier-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: GCP private offer: retroactive burn reconciliation & legal handoff

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our finance team: it looks like a portion of Glacier's usage for May–June was billed to standard on-demand SKUs rather than drawing against the private offer commitment we executed in April. Attached is a simple spend summary (Q2) that highlights the gaps.

We'd like to understand whether Redwood can (a) run a retroactive reconciliation to attribute eligible usage back to the private offer, and (b) provide an invoice amendment or credit to offset what Glacier has already paid. Our procurement lead (cc'd) will need a short written stipulation from your legal team confirming the approach before we can proceed.

Can we schedule a 30-min call this week to review reconciliation steps and required legal language? We prefer Wed–Thu morning PT.

Attachments: Glacier_PO_Spend_Summary_Q2.xlsx (xlsx, 1 file)

Thanks,
Susan Park
Head of Finance, Glacier Analytics
[susan@glacier-analytics.com]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@glacier-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: retroactive burn reconciliation & legal handoff

On Mon, Aug 2, 2027 at 9:14 AM Susan Park <susan@glacier-analytics.com> wrote:
> Quick note from our finance team: it looks like a portion of Glacier's usage for May–June was billed to standard on-demand SKUs rather than drawing against the private offer commitment we executed in April.

Hi Susan — thanks for the heads up and the summary. We can support a retroactive reconciliation and propose the following high-level plan:

- Step 1: ops-run SKU mapping (Ben) to identify eligible instances and token/VM charges.
- Step 2: finance reconcile (Marissa) to calculate credit amount and proposed invoice amendment.
- Step 3: legal sign-off on the amendment language and DocuSign routing.
- Step 4: Marketplace partner team to execute the amendment and apply credits on next invoice cycle.

Ben, Jordan — can you confirm SKU mapping ETA and whether we should hold an escrow buffer while reconciliation completes?

Susan — I'm available Wed 8/4 9–11am PT or Thu 8/5 10–12pm PT. If either works, I'll put a calendar invite together and loop Google Marketplace support for the DocuSign step. Attached is a short doc with the proposed reconciliation steps we usually follow.

Attachments: proposed-recon-steps.md (text, 1 file)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Susan Park <susan@glacier-analytics.com>
Cc: Marketplace Partner Support <marketplace-partner-support@google.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: retroactive burn reconciliation & legal handoff

Marissa / Susan — quick operational note from the ops side:

- I attached a SKU mapping export that maps Glacier's project SKUs to the private-offer SKUs we can claim. Please review for false-positives (there are a few pd-rt instances that won't qualify).
- ETA: I can run the full reconciliation scripts and produce a delta report by EOD Wed (8/4). That report will include per-SKU token/GB adjustments and a proposed credit amount.
- Recommendation: hold a 10% escrow buffer on the credit in case of reclassification during the manual review. We can release the buffer once both sides sign the amendment.

Attachments: sku-mapping.csv

Ben
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marketplace Partner Support <marketplace-partner-support@google.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Susan Park <susan@glacier-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: GCP private offer: retroactive burn reconciliation & legal handoff

Hi team,

Thanks for the update — we can assist with the amendment flow. Please provide the final credit amount and the specific contract amendment language you want to appear in DocuSign. Once we have that we will:

1) Generate an amendment PDF and DocuSign envelope;
2) Route to the Marketplace contract team for signature;
3) Apply the credit to Glacier's billing account (post-signature) per standard timing.

For planning: DocuSign turnaround is typically 2–3 business days once the envelope is created.

DocuSign prep link (internal): https://admin.google.com/ds/marketplace-amend/GLAC-RDW

Regards,
Marketplace Partner Support
marketplace-partner-support@google.com

Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 10:30:00 -0700

Susan / team — quick wrap up and agreed next steps from our side after Ben's recon ETA: 

- Wed 8/4: Ben to deliver delta reconciliation report (complete).
- Thu 8/5 by EOD: Marissa to calculate proposed credit and share amendment language for DocuSign.
- Fri 8/6: Marketplace creates DocuSign envelope; 2–3 business day sign window expected.

Deliverables I will share today: credit calculation spreadsheet, amendment language draft, and a short notes doc for Glacier procurement. I'll also create the HubSpot record and link it here.

Meeting: Scheduled Thu 8/5 10:30–11:00am PT (calendar invite sent). Agenda: recon review, confirm escrow buffer, sign routing.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/GLAC-2027-011 | https://admin.google.com/ds/marketplace-amend/GLAC-RDW | https://drive.redwood.com/teams/marketplace/recon/GLAC-Q2
